question: A milliamp is a unit of measurement of electric current, which is equal to how many amps?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.001 AMP**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A milliamp (mA) is a unit of electric current equal to **0.001 AMP**.
 
• The prefix "**milli**" means **one-thousandth (1/1000)**, so **1 milliamp is 0.001 amps**.
